items.title: グッチ、異例の値下げで高級ブランド界の掟を破る ルイ・ヴィトンは追随するか
items.summary: Gucci cut prices on bags, shoes, and ready-to-wear, including the Padlock top-handle bag (France: EUR 3,500 to EUR 2,450, -30%). Kering frames it as a 'price system reset' rather than a discount; CEO Luca de Meo said repeated past hikes pushed prices beyond what consumers would accept, causing serious volume damage. Gucci Q3 sales fell 6% YoY to EUR 1.29bn (retail -9%), 13 straight quarters of declines, hitting China and Japan hardest. Article frames Louis Vuitton's response as an open strategic question for the whole industry.

items.source: Nikkei (via WWD Japan ecosystem) / commons&sense x Gucci coverage
items.title: GUCCIと永井豪氏が奇跡の共演、SEEK COREで描く本質
items.summary: Gucci partnered with manga artist Go Nagai and magazine commons&sense on a special issue tied to the GucciCore 2027 cruise collection launch, with Nagai's Mazinger Z/Devilman characters on the cover and a limited postcard distributed at select boutiques. Activation/brand-content coverage, discounted as PR rather than independent opinion, but included for completeness on GucciCore campaign volume in Japan.

items.source: Madame Figaro Japon (via Yahoo! News Japan)
items.title: 山田涼介、池田エライザ、INI 西洸人、NiziU リマらがグッチ青山に集結
items.summary: Gucci's GucciCore launch event at Gucci Aoyama (Nov 16) drew Japanese celebrities including Yamada Ryosuke (Hey! Say! JUMP, Gucci 'Friend of the House'), Eriza Ikeda, INI's Nishi Koto, and NiziU's Rima; hip-hop artist Kohjiya performed live at the cocktail reception. Celebrity-turnout activation coverage; discounted as brand-driven rather than independent opinion but a useful read on domestic celebrity-marketing volume.

items.title: NiziU RIMA「心がときめきました」GUCCIのエレガントなブラックコーデ公開
items.summary: NiziU member Rima posted a Gucci black-outfit look from the GucciCore event; article collects fan reactions such as 'she suits high fashion after all' and 'a cut above'. Fan/celebrity-fashion coverage; sentiment positive but narrow (fandom-specific) rather than broad public opinion.

items.title: Gucci hand-paints Fall/Winter mural on Shanghai shikumen
items.summary: Gucci unveiled a hand-painted Fall/Winter campaign mural on a shikumen building at Fengshengli in Shanghai's Jing'an district, artists working on-site from a lift rather than printed banners; part of the Art Wall project (now in New York, Milan, London, Hong Kong, Shanghai). Activation coverage, discounted as brand marketing rather than independent opinion.

items.title: 报道称古驰多款包袋、成衣大幅降价，降幅最高超40%，奢侈品高价泡沫开始破裂了吗？
items.summary: Zhihu discussion thread asking whether Gucci's bag/apparel price cuts of up to 40% signal the bursting of the luxury high-price bubble; responses cite Gucci's weak Q1 revenue (EUR1.57bn, missing analyst EUR1.62bn estimate) and same-store sales down 25%, with commenters debating fading brand image, lack of design innovation, and over-expansion eroding scarcity. Genuine critical-angle community discussion (not brand-seeded).

items.title: GUCCI全球品牌代言人朴宝剑 开云集团官方更新相关内容
items.summary: Kering's official Weibo-linked account post confirming Park Bo-gum as Gucci's new global brand ambassador, announced simultaneously across platforms Nov 5. Official brand-channel SNS post; discounted as activation rather than independent opinion but tracked for ambassador-news volume on Weibo.

items.title: 구찌 한국 앰버서더 라인업.jpg
items.summary: Korean community thread compiling Gucci's Korean-face ambassador lineup (including Park Bo-gum's Nov appointment); fetch blocked by site (403) so comment sentiment could not be independently verified beyond the thread title. Retained as a dated community data point on domestic ambassador discussion volume; sentiment left unassessed pending verification.

items.title: Park Bo-gum sheds his 'brash heartthrob' persona for Gucci campaign
items.summary: Sports Kyunghyang (EN edition) covers Park Bo-gum's Gucci pictorial with a tousled, leather-jacket 'bad boy' look, captioned 'The New Core'; social reaction compiled is strongly positive, with fans calling the image a striking departure from his usual clean-cut persona ('walking the path of a bad-boy sexy hunk'). Positive but narrowly fan-driven reaction cluster around the ambassador launch.

items.title: [럭셔리월드]콧대 높던 명품도 무릎 꿇나...가격 내리는 구찌 vs 버티는 루이비통
items.summary: Analysis contrasting Gucci's decision to cut prices on bestsellers by up to 30% against Louis Vuitton's refusal to budge, framing it as a luxury-industry pricing dilemma amid falling middle-class demand; cites Gucci's 13 consecutive quarters of declining sales as the pressure behind the move.

items.title: 불황 속 구찌는 가방값 30% 내렸는데...루이비통은 망설이는 '명품의 금기'
items.summary: Segye Ilbo reports Gucci broke the luxury industry's unwritten price-only-rises rule by cutting bag prices up to 30% amid the downturn, while Louis Vuitton hesitates; situates the move within a broader consumer pushback against years of unchecked luxury price hikes.

items.title: "명품 살 돈이 없어요"...중산층 발길 끊기자 루이비통·구찌에 닥친 위기
items.summary: Herald Business reports middle-class consumers (who drive over half of LV and Gucci's revenue, spending roughly USD 2,000-3,000/year on luxury) have pulled back sharply, creating a structural crisis for both houses; frames Gucci's price cuts as a defensive reaction to this demand collapse rather than a confident strategic reset.

items.title: "사자마자 130만원 떨어�었어요"...명품값 인하에 기존 구매자들 '허탈'
items.summary: E-today covers consumer backlash: buyers who purchased Gucci and other luxury bags shortly before the price cuts describe feeling cheated, with one case losing an estimated 1.3M won in resale/replacement value overnight; captures genuine negative consumer sentiment tied directly to Gucci's pricing move, not brand-seeded.

items.title: Why discounts, store closures may not be enough for Gucci as China's luxury slowdown bites
items.summary: SCMP reports Kering closed 105 net stores in the first nine months of 2026 (targeting 125 by year-end), 25 of them Gucci, including closures in Jinan and Wuhan; Kering CFO Armelle Poulou says mainland China remains the 'major headwind' as consumer confidence stays subdued. Kering is consolidating around flagship stores in Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu, shifting focus from tourist traffic to local repeat high-net-worth clients. Critical-angle piece questioning whether discounts and closures can fix the underlying China problem.

items.title: 구찌는 가격 인하, 루이비통은 고수...명품업계의 딜레마
items.summary: Reports Gucci's choice to cut prices versus LV holding firm as emblematic of a broader luxury-industry dilemma under weakening demand, citing Kering CEO and Burberry CEO comments that years of excess price hikes exhausted consumers and hurt volumes.

items.title: 콧대 꺾인 명품...중산층 지갑 닫자 '가격 백기' By EBN
items.summary: EBN/Investing.com Korea frames luxury brands' price cuts, led by Gucci, as a symbolic 'white flag' after years of unchecked price hikes drove away middle-class shoppers; situates Gucci's move within a wider decade-long pattern finally reversing.

items.title: gucci marmont真假鉴定
items.summary: Active Xiaohongshu Q&A thread where users seek and share authentication tips for the Gucci GG Marmont bag, comparing genuine vs. counterfeit details; reflects continued organic product interest and counterfeit-authentication demand, a chronic undercurrent of Gucci's SNS conversation in China rather than a one-off news item. Published date not shown on page; treated as an evergreen/ongoing community thread, not scored as breaking news.

items.title: 명품 순위 정해준다 인정하면 개추
items.summary: Korean luxury-gallery thread ranking luxury brands (Chanel, Hermes, Louis Vuitton placed above Gucci in user rankings); undated general discussion rather than a dated news hook, included to document ongoing brand-perception chatter on Korea's largest anonymous forum community but not weighted as fresh breaking content.

items.title: 【2026年クリスマスコフレ】「グッチ ビューティ」は"レオナルド モチーフ"の限定リップや香水セットなどを発売（WWDJAPAN.com）
items.summary: WWD Japan (via Yahoo) reports Gucci Beauty's 2026 Christmas coffret line uses a 'Leonardo' motif across limited-edition lipsticks and fragrance gift sets, launched Nov 4. Standard seasonal product-launch coverage; discounted as activation/PR.

items.title: 구찌의 새로운 글로벌 앰배서더, 박보검
items.summary: Vogue Korea's official report on Park Bo-gum's appointment as Gucci global ambassador, quoting Gucci's rationale (boldness, nuanced intensity fitting the house's aesthetic vision) and Park's own statement about continuing Gucci's century-long legacy and Demna's design language. Primary activation coverage; discounted as brand-driven rather than independent opinion.

items.title: 11월 20일 주요 패션 뉴스 (Gucci Beams item)
items.summary: Hypebeast Korea's fashion-news roundup for Nov 20 includes a Gucci x Beams-related item among a mixed industry digest (also covering Gentle Monster/Joaquin Phoenix, Adidas, Sacai, Willy Chavarria); product/collab-news roundup rather than a dedicated Gucci feature, included for cross-checking news volume in the KR trade press.

items.title: グッチ、マライア・キャリーを起用した新たなホリデーキャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Trade report on Gucci's Mariah Carey-fronted holiday gift campaign (Butterfly Special Collection), online from Nov 2, in select stores from mid-November; standard activation coverage, discounted as PR rather than independent opinion.
